callback-triage.name: Callback Triage
callback-triage.description: List returns to recent jobs. Flag warranty versus billable per their marks.

closeout-photos.name: Closeout Photos
closeout-photos.description: For jobs they mark complete: required photos present or missing. Do not invent an inspection pass.

daily-board.name: Daily Board
daily-board.description: From their schedule file, list today's jobs, assigned tech, and missing packing lists.

emergency-queue.name: Emergency Queue
emergency-queue.description: Jobs they marked emergency or that match their life-safety words. Windows, tech, parts.

parts-ready.name: Parts Ready
parts-ready.description: Build or check a packing list for one job id they name. SKUs from sold PDF or them, not invented.

permit-file.name: Permit File
permit-file.description: For jobs they marked as needing a permit: number, AHJ, dates. Do not say passed unless the file says passed and dated.

quote-to-job.name: Quote To Job
quote-to-job.description: One sold estimate: parts from the PDF, schedule question, permit question. Do not schedule if not marked sold.

truck-load.name: Truck Load
truck-load.description: Jobs on one tech or crew, combined packing list, missing special orders. They load the truck.

warranty-parts.name: Warranty Parts
warranty-parts.description: One job they name: serial, install date, failed part from their file, order question. No manufacturer promise.

week-schedule.name: Week Schedule
week-schedule.description: Week view: crew PTO, overbook, sold installs without parts. Ask before moving a customer window.

preseeded_role: Job coordinator in a trade shop
